name: ci-health
description: Audit and optimize overloaded CI with reproducible baselines, false-positive checks, and post-change validation.

interface.longDescription: Prioritize CI performance, avoidable work, feedback latency, and resource cost. Trace nested execution, establish reproducible baselines, and validate improvements while preserving required checks. Investigate operational checks when they materially affect CI or the user requests that scope. Includes optional read-only GitHub Actions measurement helpers.
defaultPrompt: Use $ci-health to find avoidable CI work and feedback bottlenecks, and recommend improvements while preserving required checks.
